svg.text: The same cage values: normal fuselage vs boat hull
One set of frame rows (the classic family's), drawn with the hull switch OFF (top) and ON (bottom). Only the boat rows differ: deadrise, step, rail.
hullOn 0 · normal fuselage (flat belly between the keel corners)
hullOn 1 · boat hull (the same rows; the keel corners became the chine, the step is a ring pair)
keel line (botY: the lowest point, both modes)
chine (the keel corners, raised by botW·tan β)
